args: set -euo pipefail; r=$(grep -cE '^- \*\*R-[0-9]+\*\*' plan/requirements.md); t=$(grep -cE '^  - T-[0-9]+ ' plan/requirements.md); test "$r" -gt 0; test "$t" -ge "$r"

set -euo pipefail; for k in 'cargo fmt' 'clippy' 'cargo test' 'wasm32-unknown-unknown' 'adapters/dsh check' 'gitleaks'; do grep -q -- "$k" .github/workflows/ci.yml || { echo "missing: $k"; exit 1; }; done

objective: Independently verify the scaffold, plan documents, CI workflow and secret hygiene produced by S-01.

outputs.purpose: QA verdict for S-01 with command outputs.

risk_controls: Run in a separate QA context that never implemented the slice; do not edit implementation files; a verdict is accept or reject with the failing check and defect list.
No secret, phone number, account identifier or internal hostname in any file; run gitleaks protect --staged --redact before each commit.
Never write the owner's forbidden organisation name (grep pattern O[K]OA) or the forbidden phrase (grep pattern needs[ ]you); plain, specific prose.
rollback: Delete qa/V-01; the implementation branch is unchanged.
steps: Confirm the six plan files exist and each requirement in plan/requirements.md has at least one T- test.
Confirm every commission sentence in "What must exist from the beginning" maps to a requirement.
Run grep -rnE "O[K]OA" . and confirm it is empty (the owner's forbidden organisation name is absent).
Confirm .github/workflows/ci.yml parses as YAML and names fmt, clippy, test, wasm build, adapter check and gitleaks.
Write the verdict (accept or reject with failing check and defect list) to qa/V-01/verdict.md.
